project_type: Next.js 15 App Router web app (TypeScript, React 19) - vocational diagnostic 'OrientApp', deployed to Vercel + Neon Postgres (pgvector). Lives under web/. Original Android sources under app/ must stay untouched.
test_framework: Vitest (node environment). Tests in web/tests/*.test.ts. Currently 68 passing tests across 5 files. Auth tests mock next-auth/next-auth-google/link-user and inject getCurrentUser to test guards without the framework runtime.
test_command: cd web && npx vitest run  (or: npm run test -- --run)
verification_instructions: From web/: run all four and confirm green: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npx vitest run`, `npm run build`. CRITICAL INVARIANT: `npm run build` MUST succeed with NO environment variables set. All secrets/DB config are read lazily at request time; never at module load.
setup_instructions: cd web && npm install (node_modules already present). No DB needed for build/test.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. No live Neon DB in sandbox; DB access is lazy and guarded (query()/withTransaction from lib/db.ts return []/no-op patterns behind try/catch in read paths). Do NOT require a real DATABASE_URL for build or unit tests.
contribution_requirements: Work on branch feat/web-migration-vercel-neon; commit onto it (extends open PR #1). Do NOT create a new branch, switch branches, or push. All user-facing text in SPANISH. Preserve no-env build invariant.
key_patterns: Auth.js v5 (next-auth@beta), JWT sessions, role cached in JWT (session.user.role). isAuthConfigured() gates whether OAuth is active. Role helpers in lib/auth/roles.ts: resolveRoleForEmail, isStaffRole. Server session accessor + guards in lib/auth/session.ts: getCurrentUser(), requireRole(roles), requireStaff() -> AuthGuardResult { ok, authConfigured, error, user }. Mutation guard in lib/auth/staff.ts: authorizeStaffRequest/authorizeStaffWithRoles (OAuth-first, legacy token fallback only when !isAuthConfigured). Pages gate with requireStaff() + <AccessRestricted> fallback. Roles: STUDENT, REPORT_REVIEWER, TEST_ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN (USER_ROLES map in lib/riasec/types.ts, isStaff flag).
directory_structure: web/app/** = App Router pages + api routes. web/lib/auth/** = auth helpers. web/lib/sessions.ts = session persistence/reads (persistSession, loadSession, listSessions, updateSessionReview). web/components/** = client + server components. web/db/schema.sql = Neon schema (assessment_sessions has student_email/student_name/cohort_code, no explicit owner_user_id). web/tests/** = Vitest suites.
